record.body:
## Problem

Record ids and cross-references appear as plain text, so it is hard to see what they refer to or open them.

## Approach

Decide at plan-phase for this phase.

## Exit criteria

Known reference shapes (task, phase, requirement, record, milestone) navigate to the matching overlay or filter from lists and markdown where those references appear. Verified by UI tests and a manual look.
record.subject: deep-links
